title: Excel AI Formula Suggestions: 3 Checks Before You Trust Them
description: Excel Copilot can help complete formulas and infer reusable formulas from examples. But even a valid formula can include the wrong range, use the wrong definition, or fail on unusual data. We work through three clearly labeled illustrative examples: a missing $3,600 invoice, profit margin versus markup, and a name extraction edge case. Includes where to change formula-suggestion settings in Excel. Always verify AI-assisted calculations. #excel #copilot #excel365 #formulas #automation
